  1.25 m/s, yaw rate 20 deg/s. In `forbid` ego keeps 25 m/s south at x = -2 and is at y = 56 at

import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n
def cmps (n : Int) : Q := Units.micrometresPerSecond (n * 10000)
def degps (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: ego ↦ 1; the left-turning vehicle t is track 2.

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Int) : List Vec := [(m x0, m y0), (m x1, m y0), (m x1, m y1), (m x0, m y1)]

def structures : List Structure :=
  [ Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
  , Build.lane 11 (box 0 (-60) 4 (-10)) Build.north (enters := some 10)
  , Build.lane 12 (box 0 (-200) 4 (-60)) Build.north (leadsTo := some [11])
  , Build.lane 13 (box (-4) 10 0 200) Build.south (enters := some 10)
  , Build.lane 14 (box (-200) 0 (-10) 4) Build.west ]

/-- A pose: position, heading, speed, yaw rate. -/
structure Pose where
  pos : Vec
  heading : Vec
  speed : Q
  yaw : Q := Q.zero

def car (track : TrackId) (p : Pose) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withSignals
    (Build.withKin (Build.user track [.motorVehicle] p.pos p.heading p.speed (m 2, m 1, cm 75))
      fun k => { k with yawRate := some p.yaw })
    fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some ind, handSignal := some hand }

def at' (x y : Int) : Vec := (m x, m y)

def northNorthWest : Vec := (Units.ratio (-5) 13, Units.ratio 12 13)

def tWaitsThenTurns : Nat → Pose
  | 0 => { pos := at' 2 (-80), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | 1 => { pos := at' 2 (-30), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 8 }
  | 2 => { pos := at' 2 (-2), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 2 }
  | 3 => { pos := at' 1 4, heading := Build.north, speed := Q.zero }
  | _ => { pos := at' 0 5, heading := northWest, speed := cmps 125, yaw := degps 20 }

/-- t goes straight through the intersection. -/
def tStraight : Nat → Pose
  | 0 => { pos := at' 2 (-80), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | 1 => { pos := at' 2 (-30), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | 2 => { pos := at' 2 (-2), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | 3 => { pos := at' 2 6, heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | _ => { pos := at' 2 8, heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }

/-- t starts its turn without waiting, ego close. -/
def tTurnsAtOnce : Nat → Pose
  | 0 => { pos := at' 2 (-80), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 10 }
  | 1 => { pos := at' 2 (-30), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 8 }
  | 2 => { pos := at' 2 (-2), heading := Build.north, speed := mps 3 }
  | 3 => { pos := at' 1 0, heading := northNorthWest, speed := cmps 650, yaw := degps 20 }
  | _ => { pos := at' (-1) 5, heading := northWest, speed := mps 5, yaw := degps 20 }

/-- Ego keeps 25 m/s south. -/
def egoKeepsGoing (k : Nat) : Pose :=
  { pos := at' (-2) (156 - 25 * (Int.ofNat k)), heading := Build.south, speed := mps 25 }

/-- Ego slows and comes to rest at the edge of the intersection. -/
def egoStops : Nat → Pose
  | 0 => { pos := at' (-2) 48, heading := Build.south, speed := mps 14 }
  | 1 => { pos := at' (-2) 34, heading := Build.south, speed := mps 12 }
  | 2 => { pos := at' (-2) 22, heading := Build.south, speed := mps 8 }
  | _ => { pos := at' (-2) 15, heading := Build.south, speed := Q.zero }

/-- Ego at 15 m/s, close to the intersection when t starts its turn. -/
def egoClose (k : Nat) : Pose :=
  { pos := at' (-2) (70 - 15 * (Int.ofNat k)), heading := Build.south, speed := mps 15 }

def traceOf (ego tt : Nat → Pose) (intent : Bool) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) : Trace :=
  Build.trace 5 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ car 1 (ego k) .off .noSignal, car 2 (tt k) ind hand ]
      structures
      []
      (intents := [{ vehicle := 2, target := 10, values := [("int.left_turn", intent)] }])

def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf egoKeepsGoing tWaitsThenTurns true .left .noSignal

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene; ego slows and comes to rest at the edge of the intersection until t completes its turn. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf egoStops tWaitsThenTurns true .left .noSignal

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): t crosses the intersection straight ahead (no int.left_turn, not turning left); ego approaches from the opposite direction. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf egoKeepsGoing tStraight false .off .noSignal

def blindTrace : Trace := forbidTrace

def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf egoKeepsGoing tWaitsThenTurns true .off .noSignal

def branch_2Trace : Trace := traceOf egoClose tTurnsAtOnce true .left .noSignal

/-- `branch_3` (violated): as forbid, but t signals by arm, its indicator off. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := traceOf egoKeepsGoing tWaitsThenTurns true .off .left

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_253_o2"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("ego", 1)]
    expected := expected
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["sig.turn_indicator", "sig.hand_signal"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .violated ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_253_o2

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vEgo : Arg := .var "ego"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pConflictClearance : Term := .param "p.conflict_clearance"
def pConflictHorizon : Term := .param "p.conflict_horizon"
def pOppositeDirectionTolerance : Term := .param "p.opposite_direction_tolerance"
def pRestSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.rest_speed_tolerance"
def pTurnYawTolerance : Term := .param "p.turn_yaw_tolerance"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- The quantified variables: the intersection, ego's approach carrier, the left-turning vehicle
    and the carrier it entered the intersection from. -/
def vI : Arg := .var "i"
def vCe : Arg := .var "ce"
def vT : Arg := .var "t"
def vCt : Arg := .var "ct"

/-- f1, f13: a vehicle of the admitted aggregate. -/
def vehicle (x : Arg) : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [x, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

def occupies (x r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [x, r] []

/-- f13: carrier `c`'s entrance end is the intersection `i`. -/
def entersI (c : Arg) : Formula := .atom "st_lane_enters" [c, vI] []

def dir (c : Arg) (k : String) : Term := .measure "st_lane_direction" [c, .lit k]

/-- f13 "from the opposite direction": the designated directions of ego's carrier and of the
    carrier t entered from have a dot product below minus the tolerance. -/
def opposed : Formula :=
  .cmp (.add (.mul (dir vCe "x") (dir vCt "x")) (.mul (dir vCe "y") (dir vCt "y"))) .lt
    (.neg pOppositeDirectionTolerance)

/-- f12, f16: t is making the left turn. -/
def turningLeft : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_turning_left" [vT] [pTurnYawTolerance, pRestSpeedTolerance]

/-- f11: a left signal, by indicator or by arm. -/
def signalledLeft : Formula :=
  .or (.atom "sig_turn_indicator" [vT, .lit "left"] []) (.atom "sig_hand_signal" [vT, .lit "left"] [])

/-- f11: a left signal at some observation since t's latest stretch on its approach carrier
    began (no new start of that occupation after the signal). -/

  .since (.not (.rises (occupies vT vCt))) signalledLeft

/-- f2, f10: t entered i from `ct` (it occupied `ct` outside i, and has occupied i at every
    observation since) and has complied with NRS_484B_253_o1, as its ego, at every one of them. -/

  .since (.and (occupies vT vI) (.rule "NRS_484B_253_o1" [("ego", "t")]))
    (.and (occupies vT vCt) (.not (occupies vT vI)))

/-- f15: ego and t in conflict: their centres approach within the horizon, to a closest-approach
    distance below the clearance. -/
def conflict : Formula :=
  .and (.derived "prim_closest_approach_within" [vEgo, vT] [pConflictHorizon])
    (.cmp (.quantity "prim_closest_approach_distance" [vEgo, vT] [pConflictHorizon]) .lt pConflictClearance)

    turn left there, turning left, having entered i from an approach carrier `ct` opposed to ego's,

    (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "ct"

# NRS_484B_253_o2: task result

## Final verdict

**WITNESS_FAIL**: the node is wrong at **f10** (the `NRS_484B_253_o1` compliance composition).
`forbid`, `blind` and `branch_3` cannot reach violated or unknown. `permit`, `idle`, `branch_1`
and `branch_2` pass.

## Gate runs

1. **UNUSED_CLAIM** (every claim). I ran this by mistake on the harness skeleton before writing
   anything. Then I wrote the rule and seven witnesses (the six planned ones plus `branch_3`).
2. **WITNESS_FAIL**: `forbid`, `blind`, `branch_2` and `branch_3` came out unknown, from
   `absent_atom:st_lane_enters` and `st_lane_direction`.
   - Cause: the intersection region is itself a `travel_region`, so it was a candidate for `ct`.
     The `since` condition held trivially for it, while its lane relations were unknown.
   - Fix: the entry event became `occupies t ct ∧ ¬ occupies t i`. This states the record's
     "entered i from c_t" and decides `ct = i` false.
   - I also moved ego farther and faster, and kept t at rest until it turns.
3. **WITNESS_FAIL**: `branch_2` now passes. `forbid`, `blind` and `branch_3` come out
   **not_applicable** (decided).
   - With ego 76 m short of the intersection at 30 m/s, every applicability leaf holds at the
     turn instant except t's compliance with NRS_484B_253_o1.
4. **WITNESS_FAIL**, the same. This was a diagnostic: I put ego 263 m out at 100 m/s, still
   meeting t's projected path about 2.67 s ahead (inside the 3 s horizon, centres under 0.1 m
   apart).
   - t still fails o1 at that observation.
   - So o1's "so close … as to constitute an immediate hazard" does not depend on distance. It
     follows the same conflict test as this node's standard.
   - I then restored the realistic `forbid` geometry (30 m/s, 76 m).

Two of the six runs are unused. I stopped because the remaining failure is the node's, and no
change of witness can reach it.

## Why the node is wrong

- **f15 is symmetric.** The obligation (f14/f15) is "ego at rest or not in conflict with t", and
  the conflict test is `prim.closest_approach_within` / `prim.closest_approach_distance` between
  ego and t. Both are symmetric in their two road users.
- **The condition removes every violating case.** The applicability requires that t "has
  complied with NRS_484B_253_o1 (t as its ego) at every observation since it entered i". That
  includes the judged observation, at which t is turning (so not at rest).
- **o1 uses the same test.** As the gate shows, o1 treats an oncoming vehicle in such a conflict
  as an immediate hazard regardless of its distance. So at any observation where ego is in
  conflict with the turning t, t is in conflict with ego and not at rest, and has not complied
  with o1.
- **Result.** f10 removes exactly the observations at which this duty could be broken. The rule
  can never be violated, and `forbid` as narrated ("waited while no oncoming vehicle was close
  and now turns left … their projected closest approach lies within p.conflict_horizon below
  p.conflict_clearance") cannot be built.

**What the plan must change.** "Having so yielded" is past: t yielded *before* it made the turn.
f10 should require compliance with NRS_484B_253_o1 at every observation from t's entry into i
**up to the onset of the turn** (the observations before `drv.motion.turning_left` rose for t),
not at the judged observation. Alternatively, the record could give o1's immediate-hazard
standard a reading that a vehicle approaching from far off at speed does not meet. Either way,
the applicability text and the `forbid` narrative have to agree on which one. I did not write
either fix in Lean, because that would repair the blueprint.

## Choices the node left open

- **No narrowing declared.**
- **"approaching the intersection" (f13).** The record says ce "does not overlap i, or enters i
  from it". Taken together, the two cases are just ego occupying ce, a carrier that enters i. I
  wrote only `rel_occupies(ego, ce) ∧ st_lane_enters(ce, i)` and added no leaf for the split.
- **"since it occupied its approach carrier" (f11).** I wrote this as
  `since (¬ rises (occupies t ct)) signal`: a signal at some observation since the latest
  stretch on ct began. This form is decided false when t never signals (`branch_1`), where a
  plain "once" would stay unknown at the trace head.
- **"entered i from c_t" (f2/f10).** I wrote `since (occupies t i ∧ o1) (occupies t ct ∧
  ¬ occupies t i)`.
- **The obligation repeats the applicability's whole selection** (i, ce, t, ct with every
  relation, intention and composition) with the conflict conjoined, as rule 3c requires.
- **`branch_3` (violated)** was added to exercise the `sig_hand_signal` leaf: indicator off,
  arm signal left.

## Why I finished

The node is wrong at f10. As composed, the condition makes the duty impossible to violate, so the
planned `forbid`/`blind` witnesses cannot reach their verdicts. Gate run 4 shows this does not
depend on the witness's distances. The plan agent must re-read f10 as described above.
